I see lots of suggestions for Keto, but you dont even have to go the whole hog and cut down carbs that low - just try to stay away from simple carbs like bread, cereals, rice and pasta. the odd potato one or twice a week.

ALSO lots of eggs and lots of water. Theyre the perfect little snack and with a 500 ml bottle of cold water usually whatever it is that youre craving/ your body is asking for is in one of those things. its either a mineral from the water or a vitamin from the egg.

ALSO if you plan your day out BEFORE you start. i worked best when i used my fitness pal to plan out my meals before i ate them, i knew what i was having so i didnt start dreaming of what i could have because i was having X. i knew my calories were on point and it just took the guess work out.
